rationale: The assistant told the customer to unplug first, ran the sensible first checks (roller ring, central coupler), correctly identified the cracked/rounded-out coupler from the customer's own description, and asked for the model before pointing to a part. It did not invent any part number, gave a safe clip-on replacement procedure with no casing removal, and matched the hidden truth exactly. Only minor weaknesses: the first heading ('Turntable motor or roller guide failure') was slightly more confident than the hedged body text, and it did not explicitly suggest confirming the motor shaft turns before buying the coupler.
